name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Afroditi Latinopoulou
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection that Afroditi Latinopoulou, a Greek member of the European Parliament, holds as an elected representative. This means Greek prosecutors can now pursue a defamation case against her over a social media post from June 2020, before she was elected. The protection exists to safeguard Parliament's independence, not members personally. Parliament found no sign that the case was brought to harm her political work.

- **What changes:** Greek authorities can now prosecute her over the 2020 post.
- **Who it affects:** Afroditi Latinopoulou, a Greek member of the European Parliament.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to Greek authorities and to her.
